about.p1: Software Engineer with experience building SaaS products, fintech systems, and AI-based solutions. I've led end-to-end development of production platforms across architecture, backend, frontend, security, and cloud infrastructure.
about.p2: Specialized in Python, Node.js, Django, React, Next.js, and PostgreSQL. Today I work at Appsmart leading Bitparner, and previously contributed at Vende tu nave and DX Abstract.
about.p3: Focused on AI Engineering: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, semantic retrieval, intelligent automation, and agentic platforms where software, AI, and infrastructure meet.
